review_evidence: File contains defsection 'symbolic-arithmetic' with documentation for the GL symbolic arithmetic library
Defines defsymbolic macro framework (lines 119-367) that generates verified symbolic operations with correctness and dependency theorems

Contains 30+ defsymbolic forms for bit-vector operations: bfr-ite-bvv, bfr-ite-bss, bfr-loghead-ns, bfr-logext-ns, bfr-logtail-ns, bfr-+-ss, bfr-lognot-s, bfr-unary-minus-s, bfr-logxor-ss, bfr-sign-s, bfr-integer-length-s, bfr-abs-s, bfr-=-uu, bfr-=-ss, bfr-*-ss, bfr-<-=-ss, bfr-<-ss, bfr-logapp-nss, bfr-logapp-nus, bfr-ash-ss, bfr-logbitp-n2v, bfr-logbitp-stride-n2v, bfr-logand-ss, bfr-logior-ss, bfr-logeqv-ss, bfr-floor-ss, bfr-mod-ss, bfr-truncate-ss, bfr-rem-ss, bfr-logapp-russ, bfr-expt-su
Each defsymbolic includes :returns specification with mathematical semantics, :correct-hints for proof guidance, and generates -CORRECT and -DEPS theorems
Includes supporting lemmas: integer-length-bound-s, syntactically-true-p, syntactically-zero-p, all-nil, and extensive local lemma blocks for floor/mod/rem correctness
No indication of being generated/build artifact; authored by Sol Swords (Centaur Technology) with MIT license header

summary: Inspected books/centaur/gl/symbolic-arithmetic.lisp (57112 bytes, 1389 lines). This is an authored GL (symbolic simulation framework) library source file containing formal mathematical definitions, theorems, and a macro framework (defsymbolic) for verified symbolic bit-vector arithmetic. It includes 30+ defsymbolic forms defining operations like addition, multiplication, comparison, shifts, logops, floor/mod/rem, and exponentiation on symbolic bit vectors, each with correctness theorems and supporting lemmas. The file also contains a defsection with documentation and numerous local lemmas for proof support. This is core formal mathematics content, not a build artifact.
